建议 01 · framework

Baseline source is not prettier-clean while format:auto skips unchanged files

可自动化

control/AGENTS.md and the generated workspace AGENTS.md carry a formatting violation (a doubled blank line). format-changes.mjs normalizes only git-changed and untracked files, so a baseline tracked file is never fixed automatically, yet format:check inspects every non-ignored file. Any task whose diff does not happen to touch AGENTS.md fails the first required check and never reaches the later checks or the browser smoke.

建议改动

Format control/AGENTS.md and the app-template AGENTS.md so the refresh baseline is prettier-clean, or have format-changes.mjs also normalize baseline files that format:check covers, or add intentionally-unmanaged baseline documents to .prettierignore.

来源：Agent · retro.json

What was delivered

业务场景与交付说明

员工在线报修

员工提交标题、分类（电脑/账号/其他）与描述后立即显示待处理，刷新与重新登录后仍可从本人列表打开。

细粒度权限隔离

另一员工列表为空，直接打开他人工单地址仅提示无权访问，不显示标题、描述或状态，也没有任何处理人员操作入口。管理员可新建账号并分配 IT employee / IT handler 权限。

处理过程可追溯

处理人员可查看全部工单，开始处理后状态变为处理中并记录处理人；未填写处理说明时完成被明确拒绝，填写后完成并保存结果。

完成后只读与状态筛选

刷新后已完成工单保留处理说明，完整显示处理人与完成时间，不再提供修改或重复完成入口；员工按待处理/处理中/已完成筛选结果与工单真实状态一致。
